history.period: UNVERIFIED (verify): ~1890 per a single YouTube video description; no corroborating source found
history.summary: A popular Hanuman shrine on Bhupendra Road, Karanpara, Prahlad Plot, Rajkot (360001), locally called 'Mini Salangpur' after the famous Kashtabhanjan Hanuman temple. The deity is Hanuman in his childhood form (Balaji Maharaj / Kashtabhanjan), famed for relieving devotees of troubles and negative energies. One YouTube description claims the temple was built around 1890 by Gunatitanand Swami of the Swaminarayan sect on then-desolate land, with the child-form idol installed as 'Kashtabhanjan', and associates the complex with Mahatma Gandhi and minister Darbar Veeravala - a single weak source, UNVERIFIED. The temple's volunteers offer free food to poor and disabled people. It is one of the few Rajkot temples noted for continuous darshan access.

name: Shree Balaji Hanumanji Mandir
town_description: Rajkot is the fourth-largest city of Gujarat and a major commercial, industrial and educational hub of the Saurashtra region. Once the capital of the princely state of Rajkot and an administrative centre of the Saurashtra region, it is also the city where Mahatma Gandhi spent his early years. The city is well connected by air (Rajkot International Airport at Hirasar), rail (Rajkot Junction) and road (NH-27).
tradition: Hinduism (Hanuman devotion; Swaminarayan association claimed but unverified)

travel.road: Bhupendra Road, Karanpara, in the city centre; easy by auto-rickshaw and city buses.

visitor_information.best_time: Tuesdays and Saturdays for the peak devotional atmosphere (Saturday-evening Bhajan Sandhya); quieter on other mornings.
visitor_information.opening_hours: CONFLICT (verify): prayers1.com lists 6:00 AM - 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM - 9:00 PM daily; a YouTube description claims 24-hour darshan.
